recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-17407 unless a future work group decision narrows answerOption Reference targets or changes Questionnaire answer option modeling.
issue_request: FHIR-17407 was Published with a Persuasive resolution for STU3 Questionnaire. It asked to allow Questionnaire.item.option.value[x] to enumerate Reference values because the then-current choice only listed integer, date, time, string, and Coding; the accepted resolution was to add option.valueReference as an allowed type.
initial_application: The Jira comments identify svn revision 13918. The corresponding git-svn commit 4f586482c9960c1773e55aedbbd7aff9483fa807 changed source/questionnaire/questionnaire-spreadsheet.xml to add Reference(Any) to the Questionnaire item option value type list.
additional_context: The current build no longer uses the old STU3 option element name; the active resource source is Questionnaire.item.answerOption.value[x]. Questionnaire is active in source/fhir.ini, and source/questionnaire/structuredefinition-Questionnaire.xml includes Reference with targetProfile Resource among the answerOption value[x] types. The originating Zulip thread matches the Organization/Endpoint selection use case, and Confluence searches found no conflicting work-group record.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current active source already permits valueReference for Questionnaire answer options with Reference(Any) semantics, satisfying the published issue after the option-to-answerOption rename.
